{"n": null, "who": "CM2", "text": "Gear doors", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-03-A-00010462.0001001", "line": "LANDING GEAR DOORS......CHECK POSITION", "who": "CM2-CM3", "note": "FCOM role is CM2-CM3. {"n": null, "who": "CM2", "text": "APU area", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-03-A-00010463.0001001", "line": "APU AREA......CHECK", "who": "CM2-CM3", "note": "FCOM role is CM2-CM3. Observe that the APU inlet and outlet are clear."}}

{"n": 2, "who": "CM2", "text": "Radar OFF", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-04-A-00011881.0009001", "line": "* WXR/PWS sw......OFF", "who": "CM2", "note": "Same DU: CAPT DISPLAY mode selector OFF, F/O DISPLAY mode selector OFF, GAIN knob AUTO, TURB sw AUTO, all CM2."}}
{"n": 3, "who": "CM2", "text": "L/G Down", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-04-A-00010898.0001001", "line": "L/G lever......DOWN", "who": "CM2", "note": ""}}
{"n": 4, "who": "CM2", "text": "Wipers OFF", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-04-A-00010899.0001001", "line": "Both WIPER selectors......OFF", "who": "CM2", "note": ""}}

{"n": 5, "who": "CM2", "text": "ELEC, Bat ON", "fcom": {"status": "CONFLICT", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-04-00010900.0002001", "line": "BAT 1 pb-sw, BAT 2 pb-sw and APU BAT pb-sw......AUTO", "who": "CM2", "note": "Card says Bat ON; FCOM line is BAT 1 pb-sw, BAT 2 pb-sw and APU BAT pb-sw......AUTO CM2 (the pb-sw positions are AUTO and OFF, there is no ON label). {"n": 6, "who": "CM2", "text": "RMP 1", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-04-C-00025222.0001001", "line": "RMP 1 and 2......CHECK ON", "who": "CM2", "note": "Card names RMP 1 only; FCOM checks RMP 1 and 2 ON, green NAV light OFF, and tunes COM frequencies (VHF 1 ATC, VHF 2 ATIS/company, VHF 3 ACARS)."}}

{"n": 7, "who": "CM2", "text": "APU Fire Test", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-04-C-00010902.0001001", "line": "APU FIRE TEST pb......PRESS and MAINTAIN", "who": "CM2", "note": "Same DU first checks APU FIRE pb-sw IN and GUARDED and APU AGENT light OFF."}}

{"n": 8, "who": "CM2", "text": "APU start", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-04-C-00010903.0002001", "line": "APU START pb-sw......ON", "who": "CM2", "note": "Preceded in the same DU by APU MASTER SW pb-sw......ON CM2."}}

{"n": 9, "who": "CM2", "text": "AIR, Bleed ON", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-04-C-00010903.0002001", "line": "APU BLEED pb-sw......ON", "who": "CM2", "note": "When the APU is AVAIL. Same DU: X-BLEED rotary selector AUTO, COCKPIT TEMP and CABIN TEMP AS RQRD, EXT PWR pb AS RQRD. Do not use APU BLEED if a ground air unit is connected."}}

{"n": 10, "who": "CM2", "text": "ADIRS ON", "fcom": {"status": "CONFLICT", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-04-00011860.0004001", "line": "* ALL IR MODE selector......NAV", "who": "CM2", "note": "Card says ADIRS ON; FCOM line is ALL IR MODE selector......NAV CM2 (selector positions are OFF, NAV, ATT). Wording-level conflict, same physical action."}}

{"n": 1, "who": "CM1", "text": "Lights", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-04-00010908.0001001", "line": "* COCKPIT LIGHTS......AS RQRD", "who": "CM1-CM2", "note": "INT LT, FLOOD LT, INTEG LT including glareshield and FCU."}}
{"n": 11, "who": "CM2", "text": "Lights", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-04-00010908.0001001", "line": "* COCKPIT LIGHTS......AS RQRD", "who": "CM1-CM2", "note": ""}}

{"n": 2, "who": "CM1", "text": "MCDU Pre-Init", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-04-90000080.9000329", "line": "MCDU......ON", "who": "CM1", "note": "FMGS PRE-INITIALIZATION - CHECK THE MCDU. Same DU continues with MCDU ANNUNCIATOR LIGHTS OFF, DATA page A/C STATUS CHECK, ACTIVE NAV DATABASE CYCLE, FMS DATABASE VALIDITY CHECK, NAVAID DESELECTION AS RQRD, INIT A page FLIGHT PLAN UPLINK REQUEST, all CM1."}}

{"n": null, "who": "BOTH", "coordinated": true, "text": "EFB Initialization (Flysmart)", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-04-00021766.0001001", "line": "ALL EFB......START", "who": "ALL", "note": "FCOM role suffix is ALL (every flight crewmember). Same DU: EFB/eQRH VERSION CHECK ALL, EFB STATUS page INSERT/CHECK ALL."}}
{"n": 3, "who": "CM1", "text": "RCL pb (3 sec)", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-04-00021759.0002001", "line": "* RCL pb......PRESS 3 s", "who": "CM1", "note": ""}}

{"n": 4, "who": "CM1", "text": "A/C Acceptance, Logbook, MEL", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-04-00021759.0002001", "line": "* AIRCRAFT ACCEPTANCE......PERFORM", "who": "CM1", "note": "Same DU: LOGBOOK AND MEL/CDL ITEMS......CHECK ALL, AIRCRAFT CONFIGURATION SUMMARY......CHECK ALL, OEB......CHECK ALL. FCOM note: acceptance may be performed later but must be complete by the end of Cockpit Preparation."}}

{"n": 12, "who": "CM2", "text": "A/C Acceptance", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-04-00021759.0002001", "line": "* LOGBOOK AND MEL/CDL ITEMS......CHECK", "who": "ALL", "note": "The AIRCRAFT ACCEPTANCE......PERFORM line itself is CM1 only; CM2 takes part through the ALL items in the same DU (logbook and MEL/CDL, configuration summary, OEB)."}}

{"n": 5, "who": "CM1", "text": "Jepp Charts", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-04-00021760.0001001", "line": "* JEPPESEN CHARTS......PREPARE", "who": "ALL", "note": "Prepare charts; ensure flight plan routing and ETPs are in Jeppesen FD Pro."}}
{"n": 13, "who": "CM2", "text": "ATIS", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-04-00021760.0001001", "line": "* ATIS......OBTAIN", "who": "CM2-CM3", "note": ""}}
{"n": 14, "who": "CM2", "text": "Jepp Charts", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-04-00021760.0001001", "line": "* JEPPESEN CHARTS......PREPARE", "who": "ALL", "note": ""}}

{"n": null, "who": "PF", "text": "ACARS Initialize", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-04-00021760.0001001", "line": "* ACARS......INITIALIZE", "who": "PF", "note": "Card shows this in a PF | PM sub-block under the CM1 | CM2 card. On the ACARS INIT page input/check departure, destination, flight number and date."}}

{"n": null, "who": "PF", "text": "Prelim TPR", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-04-00021760.0001001", "line": "* PRELIMINARY TAKEOFF PERF DATA......OBTAIN", "who": "PF", "note": "From the AeroData TPR or TLR: runway, intersection, flap setting, anti-ice, packs, thrust option."}}

{"n": 1, "who": "PM", "text": "OXY, HYD, ENG Oil", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-04-D-00021790.0002001", "line": "* OXY......CHECK PRESSURE", "who": "PM", "note": "Same DU on the HYD SD page: RESERVOIR FLUID LEVEL......CHECK WITHIN NORMAL RANGE PM; on the ENG SD page: ENG OIL QUANTITY......CHECK PM. If OXY is half boxed amber, check MIN FLT CREW OXY CHART."}}

{"n": 2, "who": "PM", "text": "Flaps Position UP", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-04-D-00010909.0001001", "line": "FLAPS......CHECK POSITION", "who": "PM", "note": "FCOM says check the FLAPS position agrees with the handle position; it does not name UP. Warning: if surfaces disagree with handles, check with maintenance before applying hydraulic power."}}

{"n": 3, "who": "PM", "text": "Speed Brakes", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-04-D-00010909.0001001", "line": "* SPEED BRAKE lever......CHECK RETRACTED and DISARMED", "who": "PM", "note": ""}}

{"n": 4, "who": "PM", "text": "ACCU Press", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-04-D-00010910.0001001", "line": "* ACCU PRESS indicator......CHECK", "who": "PM", "note": "Must be in the green band; recharge with the blue electric pump if required."}}

{"n": 5, "who": "PM", "text": "Parking Brake", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-04-D-00010910.0001001", "line": "* PARK BRK handle......ON", "who": "PM", "note": "Avoid applying if one brake is above 500 C (350 C with brake fans ON) unless operationally necessary."}}
{"n": 6, "who": "PM", "text": "Brake Press", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-04-D-00010910.0001001", "line": "* BRAKES PRESS indicator......CHECK", "who": "PM", "note": ""}}

{"n": 7, "who": "PM", "text": "ALTN Brake Ck", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-04-D-00010911.0001001", "line": "CHOCKS......CHECK IN PLACE", "who": "PM", "note": "ALTERNATE BRAKING SYSTEM check, before the first flight of the day. Sequence in the DU: CHOCKS CHECK IN PLACE, PARK BRK handle OFF, BRAKE PEDALS PRESS, BRAKE PRESSURE CHECK (2 200 to 2 700 PSI at full deflection, symmetric), BRAKE PEDALS RELEASE, PARK BRK handle ON, all PM."}}
{"n": 8, "who": "PM", "text": "Emer Eqpt Ck", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-04-D-00010919.0001001", "line": "EMER EQPT......CHECK", "who": "PM-CM3", "note": ""}}

{"n": 9, "who": "PM", "text": "Rain Repellent", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-04-D-00010920.0001001", "line": "RAIN RPLNT indicators......CHECK PRESSURE and QUANTITY", "who": "PM-CM3", "note": ""}}

{"n": 10, "who": "PM", "text": "Gear Pins (3)", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-04-D-00010921.0002001", "line": "* GEAR PINS......CHECK ONBOARD and STOWED", "who": "PM-CM3", "note": "Check that the three gear pins are onboard and stowed."}}

{"n": null, "who": "PF", "text": "Overhead Panels", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-06-A-00011857.0001001", "line": "* ALL WHITE LIGHTS......OFF", "who": "PF", "note": "Card item is an umbrella for the whole OVERHEAD PANEL scan, DUs PRO-NOR-SOP-06-A-00011857 through 00011870: white lights, RCDR, EVAC, STARLINK, RESET, EXTERIOR LIGHTS, SIGNS, PROBE/WINDOW HEAT, CABIN PRESS, AIR COND, ELEC, FUEL, ENG FIRE test, MAINTENANCE PANEL, CARGO AIR COND, 3rd occupant PA, CVR test, DATA LOADER. All PF."}}

{"n": null, "who": "PM", "text": "(exterior walkaround)", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-05-A-00011096.0001001", "line": null, "who": null, "note": "The walkaround DUs in PRO-NOR-SOP-05 carry no role suffix. Role comes from PRO-NOR-SOP-06-00011855.0001001 GENERAL: the PF prepares the overhead panel, the center instrument panel and the pedestal while the PM performs the external walkaround. With augmented crew the additional crew member does the walkaround unless CM1 assigns otherwise."}}

{"n": null, "who": "PF", "text": "Front Instr Panels", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-06-B-00011875.0001001", "line": "* ISIS......CHECK", "who": "PF", "note": "Umbrella for CTR INSTRUMENT PANEL, DUs 00011875 through 00011879: ISIS, NORTH REF, ECAM switching panel, CLOCK, LDG GEAR GRVTY EXTN OFF, A/SKID & N/W STRG ON. All PF."}}

{"n": null, "who": "PF", "text": "Center Pedestal", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-06-C-00011889.0001001", "line": "RMP 1 and 2......CHECK ON", "who": "PF", "note": "Umbrella for PEDESTAL, DUs 00011889 through 00011888: RMP, ACP, PARKING BRK, COCKPIT DOOR test, SWITCHING PANEL, ENGINES (thrust levers IDLE, reversers STOWED, masters OFF, ENG START NORM), ATC/TCAS STBY. All PF."}}

{"n": null, "who": "PF", "text": "A-DIFSRIPP", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-06-D-90000090.9000245", "line": "TO/FROM......CHECK", "who": "PF", "note": "Hawaiian mnemonic, not an FCOM term. It spans FMGES PREPARATION DUs 90000090 (INIT A), 90000091 (F-PLN), 90000092 (SEC F-PLN), 90000093 (RAD NAV), 90000094 (INIT B), 90000095 (PERF), 90000096 (PROG), plus 00011904 RNP, 00020964 DERATED CLIMB, 00011905 PRESET SPEEDS. The A is not expanded on the card; ATC DATALINK COMMUNICATION (PRO-NOR-SOP-06-00013823.0001001, MSG ERASE and ADS CHECK ARMED, PF) precedes the FMGES section. Every line is PF."}}

{"n": null, "who": "PM", "text": "Check DIFSRIPP", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-06-D-00015238.0001001", "line": "* FMS PREPARATION......CROSSCHECK", "who": "PM", "note": "After the PF prepares the FMS the PM checks all data entered: departure route waypoints and constraints, flight plan vs CFP, initial cruise altitude, total track miles, fuel at destination, performance data, TRANS ALT, SEC flight plan."}}

{"n": null, "who": "BOTH", "coordinated": true, "text": "Glareshield", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-06-E-00020728.0001001", "line": "* BAROMETRIC REFERENCE......SET/CROSSCHECK", "who": "BOTH", "note": "GLARESHIELD section: LOUDSPEAKER knob SET PF-PM (00011907), EFIS CP baro SET/CROSSCHECK BOTH, FD CHECK ON, LS, ND MODE and RANGE, ADF/VOR sw AS RQRD PF-PM (00020728), FCU SPD/MACH DASHED, HDG-V/S, ALT window INITIAL EXPECTED CLEARANCE ALTITUDE PF (00011909)."}}

{"n": null, "who": "BOTH", "coordinated": true, "text": "Lateral Consoles", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-06-00011910.0001001", "line": "OXYGEN MASK TEST......PERFORM", "who": "PF-PM", "note": "Then on the ECAM DOOR/OXY SD page REGUL LO PR indication CHECK NOT DISPLAYED PF-PM. Warn the ground crew on intercom before the mask test."}}

{"n": null, "who": "BOTH", "coordinated": true, "text": "PFD & ND", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-06-00011911.0002001", "line": "* PFD......CHECK", "who": "PF-PM", "note": "INSTRUMENT PANELS: EFIS DMC selector CHECK NORM, PFD and ND brightness AS RQRD, PFD CHECK, ND CHECK, all PF-PM."}}

{"n": null, "who": "PF", "text": "PRESS, STS, FUEL", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-06-00011885.0001001", "line": "* PRESS pb......PRESS", "who": "PF", "note": "Same DU: STS pb......PRESS PF (INOP SYS compatible with MEL). FUEL is FUEL ON BOARD......CHECK PF-PM in PRO-NOR-SOP-06-00024946.0001001 (ECAM FOB vs CFP block fuel, balance and CG on FUEL SD page)."}}

{"n": null, "who": "PM", "text": "IRS Align Ck", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-06-00011912.0001001", "line": "* IRS ALIGN......CHECK", "who": "PM", "note": "POSITION MONITOR page: IRS in NAV, each IRS within 5 NM of FMS position; ND position consistent with airport, SID and navaids."}}

{"n": null, "who": "PF", "text": "RLS Ver/Fitness", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-06-90000100.9000254", "line": "RELEASE VERSION #__/ FITNESS/ FOB/ PDSC......SENT", "who": "PF", "note": "Electronically accept latest release version, fitness for duty, FOB and PDSC time via OPS CTRL MSG page in ACARS."}}
{"n": null, "who": "PM", "text": "FUEL", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-06-00024946.0001001", "line": "* FUEL ON BOARD......CHECK", "who": "PF-PM", "note": ""}}

{"n": null, "who": "PM", "text": "ATC Clearance", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-06-90000101.9000253", "line": "ATC clearance......CONFIRM", "who": "PM", "note": "Via VHF, ACARS PDC or CPDLC DCL."}}

{"n": null, "who": "BOTH", "coordinated": true, "text": "Legs Verification", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-06-90000102.9000255", "line": "DEPARTURE LEGS VERIFICATION......PERFORM", "who": "BOTH", "note": "PF reads from the ND in PLAN mode with CSTR on; PM verifies against flight plan, Jeppesen charts and ATC clearance. Finish by confirming F-PLN DIST and destination EFOB against the release."}}

{"n": null, "who": "BOTH", "coordinated": true, "text": "Departure Briefing", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-06-00011915.0001001", "line": "* DEPARTURE BRIEFING......PERFORM", "who": "BOTH", "note": "Threat based departure briefing per FOM."}}

{"n": null, "who": "PF", "text": "*Load FMC", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-07-A-00021319.9000330", "line": "ACARS PERF page......SELECT “*LOAD FMC”", "who": "PF", "note": "Select the prompt when it appears; the FMS uploads final weight data and takeoff performance."}}

{"n": null, "who": "PF", "text": "LCO Check", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-07-A-00021319.9000330", "line": "LOAD CLOSEOUT (LCO)......CHECK", "who": "PF-PM", "note": "Both crew members check flight number/date, aircraft, crew count, TOF, TOW vs planned, TOB, jumpseats, ZFW/ZFWCG, NOTOC, AVI, FAM. Then ZFW/ZFWCG CHECK/REVISE PF and PM, and LOADCLOSEOUT (MACTOW) CG vs ECAM CG CHECK PF-PM."}}

{"n": null, "who": "PM", "text": "LCO x-check", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-07-A-00021319.9000330", "line": "LOAD CLOSEOUT (LCO)......CHECK", "who": "PF-PM", "note": "Same PF-PM line. FCOM also has LOAD CLOSEOUT VERBAL CROSS-CHECKS (passenger and jumpseat count announced by CM2 and verified by CM1 against the Flight Deck Report; flight and tail number announced by CM2 and verified by CM1 against the release; remarks announced by CM2) which the card does not show."}}

{"n": null, "who": "BOTH", "coordinated": true, "text": "Min RLS Fuel Check", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-07-A-00011914.0001001", "line": "MIN RLS FUEL......CHECK", "who": "PF-PM", "note": "ECAM FOB above Minimum Release Fuel on the flight plan."}}

{"n": null, "who": "PF", "text": "*Insert PERF uplink", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-07-A-00021320.0001001", "line": "TAKEOFF PERFORMANCE......UPLINK FLX or UPLINK TOGA", "who": "PF", "note": "If takeoff data will be uplinked. Then FLAPS/THS reminder......INSERT PF. Manual entry branch (T.O SHIFT, V1 VR V2, FLX TO TEMP, THR RED/ACC, ENG OUT ACC, all PF) is not on the card."}}

{"n": null, "who": "PF", "text": "TPR check", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-07-A-00021320.0001001", "line": "FINAL TAKEOFF DATA (TPR/TLR)......CHECK", "who": "PF-PM", "note": "Both check aircraft/flight/date, wind/OAT/QNH, FINAL TPR, remarks, runway/intersection, EO departure procedure, packs, V speeds, flap config/THS, FLEX/TOGA, GTOW vs MTOW. Then FMS TAKEOFF DATA CHECK/REVISE PF and PM."}}

{"n": null, "who": "PM", "text": "TPR x-check", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-07-A-00021320.0001001", "line": "FINAL TAKEOFF DATA (TPR/TLR)......CHECK", "who": "PF-PM", "note": ""}}

{"n": null, "who": "BOTH", "coordinated": true, "text": "MCDU pages set", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-07-A-00011059.0001001", "line": "FMS PERF TO page......SELECT", "who": "PF", "note": "Two lines in the DU: FMS PERF TO page......SELECT PF and FMS F-PLN page......SELECT PM. {"n": null, "who": "BOTH", "coordinated": true, "text": "Set Seating Positions", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-07-A-00011058.0001001", "line": "SEATS, SEAT BELTS, HARNESSES, RUDDER PEDALS, ARMRESTS......ADJUST", "who": "PF-PM", "note": "Eyes aligned with the red and white balls. The FCOM steps that sit in this position of the procedure are PITOT COVERS......REMOVED PF (PRO-NOR-SOP-07-A-90000430.9000392) and AIR CONDITIONING UNITS......CHECK DISCONNECTED PF, EXT PWR pb......CHECK AVAIL PF, EXT PWR DISCONNECTION......REQUEST PF (PRO-NOR-SOP-07-A-00011060.0001001), which are the likely referent but are not confirmed as such by any manual."}}

{"n": null, "who": "PM", "text": "Request Push Clearance", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-07-B-00011040.0004001", "line": "PUSHBACK/START CLEARANCE......OBTAIN", "who": "PM", "note": "FCOM places this line at the head of AT PUSHBACK/START CLEARANCE (the Before Start flow section). {"n": 1, "who": "PF", "text": "Beacon ON", "fcom": {"status": "VERIFIED", "ident": "PRO-NOR-SOP-07-B-00011064.0001001", "line": "BEACON sw......ON", "who": "PF", "note": "When cleared for start or pushback."}}
